tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: Shop profile: name, address, phone, hours, what it works on, what it does not, booking policy, and who verified the listing. Read-only.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Services the shop offers in plain language, with exclusions. Read-only.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Open drop-off windows for the next N days from the shop booking policy. Not a live calendar; the shop confirms every request. Read-only.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask the shop for a quote. Creates a request the shop answers by phone or text; returns a reference and status "requested". The shop confirms estimates directly.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Request a drop-off appointment. Creates a booking request the shop confirms or declines; returns a reference and status "requested". No payment, no OTP; the shop calls or texts the contact to confirm.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Status of a quote or booking request by reference: requested, confirmed or declined. Returns no contact data. Read-only.
